svg.text: System level cache, textbook form: 8 MiB, 16 ways, 4096 sets, memory side, every index bit hashed
Not a CPU cache in the usual sense. It sits on the memory side of coherence, holds what the L2s evict, and is exclusive of them.
every index bit is a hash
behind the coherence point, in front of the controllers
